summary: Staff and admins can now open one page per person to view and edit their account, membership, newsletters and public profile, with a reason and an audit entry for every change.
detailed_changes: A new person page joins the account, contact details, membership, mailing contact, per-newsletter subscriptions and public profile, and is linked from Users, Members and Subscribers (#568).

Staff get a People section in the Audience menu and can view and edit the details of public accounts; security actions, roles and erasure stay with admins as before. The old /staff/members link now opens People (#571).

Staff can edit mailing-list subscribers: change their name or email, unsubscribe them from one newsletter, send a confirmation email to resubscribe them, and suppress or unsuppress the address. A new subscription always waits for the subscriber to confirm it, and only admins can delete a subscriber (#569).
Admins can grant or remove complimentary access, which unlocks paid content without changing Stripe billing, keep an encrypted internal note on a member, and toggle a member's newsletters (#570).
Staff and admins can edit or reset a member's display name, bio and avatar from the person page or the moderation queue (#572).
Staff-started email changes only send a confirmation to the new address; the change applies once the member confirms it, and Cloudron SSO accounts keep their name and email locked (#573).

Fixed: confirming an account email change no longer fails when the member is subscribed to a newsletter that has no legacy mailing list; those subscriptions now move to the new address and ask for confirmation (#573).
Every people change needs a reason, writes an audit entry without personal values, and newsletter changes record a consent event with the source "staff" (#574).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff, admins and super admins; members whose details or subscriptions are changed by staff
Public impact: members with complimentary access can read paid content; no public page changes

Internal impact: UserPolicy, MembershipPolicy, new MailingContactPolicy and ProfilePolicy, UserDetailsUpdater, StaffContactService, memberships comp and staff note columns, ConsentAction unsuppressed and contact_updated, people-actions rate limit
